title: Spicy Pea and Split Lentil Tagine
description: A hearty North African stew made with split lentils, peas, and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add split lentils, peas, arabian spice mix, salt, black pepper, and cumin. Stir well.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until lentils are tender.
Stir in remaining 1 tbsp olive oil.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
